'''Paul Todd Feldman Feldman's Force Deck''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Paul Todd Feldman]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/Force.html Feldman's Force Deck], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991012031059/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/Force.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah (location)|Dagobah-L-dagobah.gif|label=Dagobah}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dagobah Sense/Alter
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Feldman LS Force Deck Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
A [[Dagobah (location)|Dagobah]] deck with four [[Yoda]]s, eight [[Sense]] and five [[Control]]. Kyle Heuer (Red 7) called it "perhaps the best Light Side deck I have ever seen".<ref name="torch" />
